howto.what: 该技能通过 Chat SDK 桥接让 NanoClaw 支持 Webex 频道：复制适配器并注册，安装固定版本依赖，构建并运行测试；然后需手动创建 Webex bot 并设置令牌和 webhook 密钥才能接收消息。
howto.when: 当你说“添加 Webex 频道”“接入 Webex”等要求时触发；也用于 NanoClaw 安装流程中的频道配置步骤。

say.text: 帮我添加 Webex 频道
say.note: 它会执行复制、注册、安装依赖并跑测试。

say.text: 把 Webex 集成到项目里
say.note: 还会提示你创建 bot 并配置凭据。

say.text: 设置 Webex 机器人并连接
say.note: 引导完成令牌和 webhook 密钥设置。

howto.what_en: This skill enables Webex channels for NanoClaw via the Chat SDK bridge: it copies and registers the Webex adapter, installs a pinned dependency, builds, and runs an integration test. You then create a Webex bot and configure its token and webhook secret to receive messages.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add or integrate a Webex channel, or during NanoClaw's channel-setup flow.

say_en.text: Add the Webex channel to my project.

say_en.note: Runs the steps and asks for credentials.
Guides through token and webhook setup.
